title: GenState-AI: State-Aware Dataset for Text-to-Video Retrieval on AI-Generated Videos
abstract: arXiv:2603.14426v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing text-to-video retrieval benchmarks often permit matching from static appearance, making it difficult to determine whether models capture state changes and final outcomes. We introduce GenState-AI, a benchmark comprising 956 AI-generated videos and 195 verified state-change queries across Toy, Cartoon, Home, and Manipulation domains. Its construction uses prompt-controlled variants that target either conflicting temporal/state outcomes or semantic substitutions. Following human verification, all valid videos contribute to subset-level retrieval pools, while complete query-specific triplets support diagnostic hard-negative ordering. We evaluate VCF-Lik, Qwen3-VL, and LanguageBind using both standard Recall@K and triplet-based consistency metrics. translated_title: GenState-AI：面向AI生成视频的文本到视频检索状态感知数据集
translated_abstract: 现有的文本到视频检索基准往往允许模型仅凭静态外观完成匹配，因此难以判断模型是否真正捕捉到了状态变化和最终结果。我们提出了GenState-AI，这是一个包含956个AI生成视频和195个经人工验证的状态变化查询的基准，涵盖玩具、卡通、家居和操作四个领域。其构建方法采用提示词控制的视频变体，分别针对相互冲突的时间/状态结果或语义替换。经过人工验证后，所有有效视频构成子集级检索池，而完整的查询特定三元组则支持诊断性的难负样本排序。我们使用标准Recall@K指标和基于三元组的一致性指标对VCF-Lik、Qwen3-VL和LanguageBind进行了评估。结果显示，Qwen3-VL（8B）在平均R@1和三元组一致性上表现最佳，而LanguageBind获得了最高的语义判别准确率。然而，更强的检索表现……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向AI生成视频的状态感知文本到视频检索基准GenState-AI，通过提示词控制视频变体与人工验证的状态变化查询，揭示了现有检索模型难以超越静态外观、真正捕捉状态变化与最终结果的问题。
en_tdlr: GenState-AI introduces the first state-aware text-to-video retrieval benchmark for AI-generated videos, using prompt-controlled video variants and 195 human-verified state-change queries to reveal that current retrieval models struggle to capture state changes and final outcomes beyond static appearance.
